jobs.description:
Sales Advisor – Temporary Position (Sick Leave Cover) - Swatch Group

Sales Advisor – Temporary Position (Sick Leave Cover)
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
• We are looking for Sales Advisors to join one of our shops in Madrid on a temporary basis to cover two sick leave absences.
• Reporting to the Store Manager, the main functions of the Sales Advisor are:
• Customer Service
• To ensure a luxury selling ceremony
• To achieve and exceed individual Sales Goals
• To maintain Merchandising guidelines
• Maintenance of the Store
• Stock Control
• Other administrative tasks
• Profile
• Previous experience in retail or customer-facing roles is a plus
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Sales‑driven mindset and ability to work in a fast‑paced environment
• Availability to work during the full sick‑leave coverage period
• Team spirit and a proactive attitude
• Professional requirements
• You will be a communicative person, results and customer service oriented and you will have an eye for detail.
• Languages
• Conversation level of English.
• Knowledge in other language would be a plus
• Contact
• empleo@es.swatchgroup.com
• Job location
• PRECIADOS/GOYA/CASTELLANA
• 28013 MADRID (Madrid Province)
• Spain

• Edificio C, Miniparc I

jobs.title: Store Manager – Pop Up Ibiza
jobs.location: 07800 ALCOBENDAS (Islas Baleares) Spain Company address The Swatch Group (España
jobs.description:
Store Manager – Pop Up Ibiza - Swatch Group

Store Manager – Pop Up Ibiza
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
We are looking for a Store Manager to lead our seasonal pop‑up in Ibiza from June to September. If you bring strong retail expertise, a proactive mindset, and the ability to elevate both team performance and customer experience, this role offers an exciting summer challenge.
Key 
• Responsibilities
Drive revenue growth, oversee daily operations, and lead the sales team with a hands‑on, people‑first approach.
Develop strategies and action plans to achieve sales targets through clientelling, exceptional service, events, partnerships, and traffic‑driving initiatives.
Ensure a consistent, high‑quality in‑store experience aligned with brand standards.
Think strategically and make decisions that elevate store performance.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, and manage administrative tasks while adapting to evolving business needs.
Maximize inventory efficiency and maintain strong cash‑control and loss‑prevention practices.
Profile
Previous experience as a Store Manager or Assistant Manager in retail.
Positive leadership, strong people skills, and the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
Passion for customer experience and creating meaningful interactions.
Analytical mindset, results orientation, and agile decision‑making.
Professional requirements
Flexibility, energy, and enthusiasm to be part of a special seasonal project.
Availability to work in rotating shifts.
Intermediate computer skills (Microsoft Office).
Languages
Conversation level of English.
Knowledge in other language would be a plus.
Contact

jobs.title: Sales Advisor 100% - Genève
jobs.location: 1215 Genève (Geneva) Switzerland Company address The Swatch Group Les Boutiques
jobs.description:
Sales Advisor 100% - Genève - Swatch Group

Sales Advisor 100% - Genève
The company
Swatch Group est un leader mondial dans la conception, la fabrication et la vente de montres, bijoux, ainsi que de mouvements et composants horlogers de haute précision. Le groupe se distingue également comme acteur clé dans la fabrication de systèmes électroniques innovants, utilisés dans l’horlogerie et d’autres secteurs industriels.
Swatch Group Les Boutiques SA gère les réseaux de distribution multimarques en Suisse et dispose de plusieurs boutiques à travers le pays. Afin de renforcer nos équipes à Genève, nous recherchons un(e) :
Sales Advisor 100%
• Job description
• Vous contribuerez activement au bon fonctionnement du point de vente en garantissant un accueil client de qualité et en assurant une présentation soignée des produits.
• Tâches :
• Accueillir et accompagner la clientèle en offrant un service personnalisé.
• Participer activement aux opérations quotidiennes et soutenir l’équipe en boutique.
• Contribuer à la gestion de la caisse et aux opérations d’encaissement.
• Veiller à la bonne tenue de l’espace de vente : présentation des produits et respect des standards de merchandising.
• Appliquer les procédures internes mises en place par la société
• Profile
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience préalable dans la vente.
• Des connaissances dans le domaine de l'horlogerie constituent un sérieux atout.
• Professional requirements
• Vous êtes proactif, à l’aise dans les relations humaines et faites preuve de flexibilité.
• Vous êtes orienté client et disposez d’une bonne capacité d’écoute.
• Vous avez une excellente présentation et un sens aigu du service.
• Vous avez de la facilité avec les tâches administratives.
• Languages
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais ; la connaissance d'une autre langue est un atout.
• Vous recherchez un nouveau défi et êtes prêt à entrer dans l’aventure ? Le monde de l’horlogerie vous passionne ? N’hésitez pas à postuler directement en ligne.
• Contact
• Carla Tenthorey
• Job location
• 25 Route de l’Aéroport CP 852
• 1215 Genève (Geneva)
• Switzerland
• Company address
• The Swatch Group Les Boutiques Ltd
• Länggasse 85
• P.O. Box
• CH-2504 Biel / Bienne

jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
The Ideal candidate must be experienced in luxury retail sales and operations management with a strong focus on driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The Luxury Assistant Manager leads retail operations, helps manage selling and supervises staff. He/she must possess the ability to build revenue and operational excellence.
Profile
• •Must possess excellent computer skills such as; Using operating systems(Windows, SAP, Cegid and emailing (Microsoft Outlook)
• •Performs and manages daily activities of operating luxury boutique as per company standards inclusive of maximizing inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• •Delegate tasks to the sales team.
• •Develop sales incentives and rewards
• .•Deliver sales results as per company goals.
• •Ensures a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• •Brings positive recognition to the Omega brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude, professionalism and in-depth brand knowledge
• .•Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs
• .•Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• •Lead employees by example, uphold company initiative and confidentiality
• Professional requirements
• Required Skills:
• Must possess luxury experience
• Minimum 3 years operations management experience
• Excellent selling and customer service skills.
• Superior communications skills: spoken and written.
• Inventory management expertise.
• Luxury retail experience preferred.
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount

jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules - Swatch Group

Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules
The company
We are looking for an entrepreneurial and technically minded Senior Business Development Manager to accelerate our growth across the DACH region. You will drive market expansion for innovative electronic modules focused on Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power applications.
Our solutions enable next-generation Asset Tracking, Localization, Identification, and IoT connectivity for industries such as Logistics, Warehousing, Avionics, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Large Enterprise environments.
This role is designed for a high-energy sales professional who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution, who enjoys building customer relationships in the field, identifying market opportunities, and turning technical innovation into commercial success.
Why to Join Us
Be part of a growing, innovation-driven business
Work with cutting-edge ultra-low-power technologies
Direct impact on strategic growth and market expansion
High visibility within the organization and close collaboration with leadership
Dynamic international environment with entrepreneurial spirit
Opportunity to shape future connected-device ecosystems
Job description
Your Mission
Develop and execute the business development strategy for the DACH region
Drive sustainable revenue growth aligned with Business Unit targets
Identify and win new business opportunities within target verticals
Build strong relationships with OEMs, system integrators, distributors, and strategic partners
Support the on-boarding and mentoring of future sales talents as the organization grows
Your 
• Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales
Identify opportunities and close deals as a result of the full sales cycle support
Achieve and measure Biz Dev KPIs and ensure alignment with the Business Unit revenue targets
Develop strategic account plans and regional growth strategies
Identify new customers and market opportunities
Conduct customer visits and maintain strong field presence across the region
Represent the company at trade fairs
Drive C-level interaction between EM and customers / eco-system partners
Lead the commercial negotiations and drive the execution of development contracts with the different internal and external stakeholders (R&D, legal, quality and logistics)
Strategic Collaboration
Work closely with BUs Product Management, and Development to refine go-to-market strategies
Provide market feedback to influence product roadmap and innovation priorities
Collaborate with Marketing Communication teams to support campaigns, and market positioning
Interface effectively with Account Managers
Market & Technical Engagement
Understand customer application requirements and translate them into solution opportunities
Promote Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power technologies in customer ecosystems
Support customers during evaluation and early project phases
Profile
Personality & Mindset
Strong business acumen with ability to handle strategic and action level aspects
Hands-on and action-oriented personality
“Hunter” attitude, strong commercial instinct and negotiation capability
Self-driven, autonomous, able to prioritize and highly customer-focused
Strong networking and relationship-building skills
Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for technology and innovation
Ideal Candidate 
• Profile
You are not just a salesperson — you are a business builder. You enjoy opening doors, understanding customer pain points, and transforming technical innovation into long-term partnerships. You are equally comfortable discussing strategy with management as walking a floor with end users. You thrive in dynamic environments and want to actively shape growth rather than groom existing business.
Professional requirements
Experience & 
• Profile
Proven experience in electronic components, module, or IoT solution sales (min. 10years)
Experience in business development within technical B2B environments
Excellent market knowledge and familiarity with industries such as logistics, healthcare, industrial automation, or enterprise IoT
Good understanding of wireless technologies, ideally Bluetooth® Low Energy
Experience working within the DACH business culture and environment
Self-starter and high intrinsic drive to deliver business results
Experience in contractual work
Languages
Fluent English required. Ideal: Fluent German. Bonus: French
